## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` pass
- [ ] New UI text is in both `app/src/i18n/da.ts` and `en.ts`
- [ ] New dependencies are pinned to an exact version at least two weeks old, and `npm run notices` was re-run
- [ ] A decision worth remembering is in `docs/DECISIONS.md`
